faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about our UAE maid and domestic worker services
faq.q1: How do I book a maid service?
faq.a1: Submit an enquiry or contact the team. Review availability, costs, documents and the agreement before confirming a service.
faq.q2: What candidate details can I review?
faq.a2: Ask the team which identity details, documents and experience notes are available for the individual profile. A review is not a safety guarantee.
faq.q3: How is a replacement request reviewed?
faq.a3: The team reviews the agreement, service stage, case details and available options. Do not assume a free or guaranteed replacement.
faq.q4: Do you help with maid visa and sponsorship?
faq.a4: Yes. We provide full maid visa assistance and sponsorship transfer services.
faq.a5: We provide maid and domestic worker services across all UAE emirates, including Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah and Umm Al Quwain. Contact us to confirm availability for your requirement.
